response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced, versatile full-stack and systems engineer with 15+ years of shipping production software across web, embedded, and infrastructure domains, but his resume shows minimal direct experience with AI/GenAI systems, RAG architectures, vector databases, or multi-agent frameworks. Only his most recent role (since April 2025) mentions AI-agent infrastructure and MCP tooling, which is too brief and vague to demonstrate the 8+ years of AI-solution development required for this Staff-level GenAI role.
strengths: Deep, broad engineering background (15+ years) across multiple languages, platforms, and domains
Recent hands-on exposure to MCP and agentic workflow tooling at re:cinq
Strong track record of technical leadership, mentoring, workshops, and open-source contribution
concerns: No demonstrated 8+ years of AI-driven solution development as required by the role
No evidence of experience with vector databases, RAG pipelines, or LLM evaluation/observability
No listed cloud platform (AWS/GCP/Azure) AI system design experience or multi-agent framework (LangGraph/CrewAI) expertise

key_factors.factor: Lack of AI/GenAI-specific experience (RAG, vector DBs, multi-agent frameworks)
Insufficient tenure in AI-focused roles (only ~4 months vs required 8+ years)
Strong general software engineering and technical leadership background
